acceptanceCriteria: An accepted contract defines per-stage repository/base/integration declarations, supported exact host versions and effort mappings, bounded longer or resumable execution, failure modes and rollback.

A real multi-repository supervised program provisions isolated participant worktrees, binds all candidate commits/trees and independent review, and integrates each approved candidate only into its designated checkout.
Codex, Claude Code and OpenCode v2 adapters each pass focused protocol, prompt/output handling, resume and cancellation/descendant-cleanup checks; missing capabilities fail closed.
Role or stage effort is configurable within an owner policy allowlist; unsupported settings are refused before launching a host and no global low-only constraint remains.

Policy-bounded execution supports stages beyond one hour or checkpointed continuation preserving session/worktrees; interruption, restart and expiration retain correct ownership without duplicate integration.
Host-specific live qualification retains actual versions, invocation identity, outcome and uncertainty, plus recovery and independence evidence; a stub or another host passing is not equivalent.
Consumer configuration/docs are usable without private planning access, the change is independently reviewed and integrated, and native completion is recorded only after required evidence passes.
